name: Manga Comic Con Vietnam
blurb: A Ho Chi Minh City manga, comics and cosplay convention last held in July 2023, with no new edition announced since.
notes: Official homepage (mangacomiccon.vn) currently shows only 'coming soon... Contact Us: toanpham@vietfest.vn' with a link to the archived 2023 microsite (2023.mangacomiccon.vn); the page's <title> still reads '...2024' but that is stale metadata, not an announced edition. No JSON-LD, date text, hero images or guest page exist on the live site; the only usable image is the MCCV logo (used as cover). WebSearch (2) found a Facebook page (facebook.com/mccvnn) and press coverage of the 2023 edition but no announcement of a 2024, 2025 or 2026 edition. Last confirmed edition per the con's own archived 2023 site: dates '29/7 - 30/7/2023', venue 'Trung tam Trien lam Sky Expo (Quan 12)' = Sky Expo Exhibition Center, District 12, Ho Chi Minh City. Marked inactive given 3+ years of 'coming soon' with no new dates announced; re-check mangacomiccon.vn or the Facebook page for a revival. No guests recorded (no edition in the tracked window). Kept the given id/name.
